snippet.title: Today is Trash Day! | Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Get TRASH DAY 🗑️ on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314580/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=2026_launch&utm_content=launch_trailer

Up to six opinions. One terrible plan. Trash Day is out now on Steam for 10% off until October 27!!

Every raccoon dreams of Raccoon Paradise. Unfortunately, you and your friends are currently locked up in Animal Control. Break out, steal a wagon, load it with the finest trash you can find, and haul it across six areas to get there.

🦝 About Trash Day
- Online co-op for up to 6 players
- Six unique areas, from Animal Control to the Junkyard
- Physics-driven chaos (things can and will go wrong)
- Steal, scrounge, and scavenge anything not nailed down
- Built for shouting at your friends

🎵 Music: "Get Up!" by TRASH DAY
Listen on Spotify ► https://open.spotify.com/track/3MAvDDp5U2EOBA6kQCTZPv

🌐 https://trashdaygame.com
🎮 Discord ► https://discord.gg/rCM4PHcXCj

Made by Off By One Games, a small team with over a decade of experience working together on Rocket League.

#trashday  #coopgames  #indiegames
